title: Toy Bricks Stop: Energy Costs Soar
story: BLOK, the toy brick maker, paused its factory work because the power bill got too high. They say the cost to keep the machines running is way more than usual. This means fewer toy bricks for a while.
storyBig: BLOK has temporarily halted production due to rising energy costs, as it becomes unsustainable to maintain operations with current electricity prices. This could lead to a shortage of toy bricks in the market.
think: Why do high energy prices make things cost more?
bull: This might mean BLOK finds new, cheaper energy ways!
bear: Toy bricks could become hard to find for a bit.

rss: I'd rather pay thousands on a holiday: Meet the pensioners spending the kids' inheritance
title: Grandparents Choose Fun Over Savings!
story: Some grandparents are spending their money on fun vacations instead of saving it up. This means they are living life to the fullest now rather than keeping it for later.
storyBig: A growing trend among retirees is to prioritize spending on life experiences rather than conserving savings for future generations. This shift impacts how money moves in recreational and travel industries.
think: What would you choose to do with savings: keep or spend?
bull: Travel companies might see more visitors soon!
bear: Less saved money might mean fewer gifts later.
